title: Intermediário superior
description: Narrar com precisão, expressar arrependimento e desejos, usar estruturas de discurso e nuances naturais.
goal: Você se expressa com naturalidade sobre a maioria dos temas, com erros raros e sem perder a fluidez.

units.title: Narrativas precisas
units.goal: Contar histórias com a sequência correta de tempos verbais.

lessons.title: Past perfect
lessons.objective: Marcar qual ação aconteceu antes de outra no passado.
lessons.explanation:
**Had + particípio** indica uma ação anterior a outra ação passada:

- *When I arrived, the film had already started.*
- *She didn't recognize him because he had changed a lot.*

Use o past perfect só quando for preciso deixar a ordem clara.

key_phrases.en: By the time we got there, they had left.
key_phrases.pt: Quando chegamos, eles já tinham saído.

key_phrases.en: I had never seen the sea before.
key_phrases.pt: Eu nunca tinha visto o mar antes.

exercises.prompt: When I called, she ___ already ___ (leave).
I had ___ (never) been abroad before that trip.
answers: never

exercises.prompt: Quando cheguei, o ônibus já tinha partido.
answers: When I arrived, the bus had already left.
When I got there, the bus had already left.

exercises.prompt: Monte a frase: ele já tinha comido quando ela chegou
answers: He had already eaten when she arrived.

lessons.title: Past continuous e past simple juntos
lessons.objective: Descrever o cenário (past continuous) interrompido por um evento (past simple).
lessons.explanation:
- **Past continuous** (*was/were + -ing*): ação em andamento, pano de fundo.
- **Past simple**: evento que interrompe ou acontece.

*I was cooking when the phone rang.*
*While they were talking, someone knocked on the door.*

key_phrases.en: It was raining when we left.
key_phrases.pt: Estava chovendo quando saímos.

key_phrases.en: While I was waiting, I read a book.
key_phrases.pt: Enquanto eu esperava, li um livro.

exercises.prompt: I ___ a shower when the power went out.
While we ___ (walk) home, it started to rain.
answers: were walking

exercises.prompt: Enquanto eu dirigia, meu celular tocou.
answers: While I was driving, my phone rang.
While I was driving my phone rang.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct sentence.
options: I was sleeping when the alarm rang.
I slept when the alarm was ringing.
I was sleep when the alarm rang.
I sleeping when the alarm rang.
exercises.explanation: Sono em andamento interrompido pelo alarme.

lessons.title: Futuro perfeito e futuro contínuo
lessons.objective: Falar de ações concluídas ou em andamento no futuro.
lessons.explanation:
- **Future perfect** (*will have + particípio*): algo já concluído até um momento futuro. *By June, I will have finished the course.*
- **Future continuous** (*will be + -ing*): ação em andamento no futuro. *This time tomorrow, I will be flying to Lisbon.*

key_phrases.en: By next year, I will have graduated.
key_phrases.pt: No próximo ano, eu já terei me formado.

key_phrases.en: I'll be working at 9 tomorrow.
key_phrases.pt: Amanhã às 9h estarei trabalhando.

exercises.prompt: By 2030, they ___ the new bridge. (concluída)
This time next week, I will ___ (lie) on the beach.
answers: be lying

exercises.prompt: Até sexta, eu terei terminado o relatório.
answers: By Friday, I will have finished the report.

exercises.prompt: Monte a frase: às oito estarei dirigindo para casa
answers: I will be driving home at eight.

units.title: Desejos, arrependimentos e hipóteses
units.goal: Falar do que poderia ter sido diferente e de situações impossíveis.

lessons.title: Third conditional
lessons.objective: Falar de arrependimentos e situações passadas que não aconteceram.
lessons.explanation:
Estrutura: **if + past perfect, would have + particípio**.

- *If I had studied harder, I would have passed.*
- *She would have come if she had known.*

Na lingua falada, *would've* e *'d've* são comuns.

key_phrases.en: If I had known, I would have helped.
key_phrases.pt: Se eu tivesse sabido, teria ajudado.

key_phrases.en: We wouldn't have missed the flight if we had left earlier.
key_phrases.pt: Não teríamos perdido o voo se tivéssemos saído antes.

exercises.prompt: If you ___ earlier, you would have caught the bus.
I would ___ (call) you if I had had your number.
answers: have called

exercises.prompt: Se ela tivesse estudado, teria passado no exame.
answers: If she had studied, she would have passed the exam.
If she had studied, she would have passed the test.

exercises.prompt: Monte a frase: eu teria ido se tivesse tido tempo
answers: I would have gone if I had had time.

lessons.title: Condicionais mistos
lessons.objective: Combinar passado e presente em uma mesma frase condicional.
lessons.explanation:
Às vezes a condição é passada e o resultado é presente (ou o contrário):

- *If I had taken that job, I would be rich now.* (passado → presente)
- *If I were more organized, I would have finished it.* (presente → passado)

key_phrases.en: If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.
key_phrases.pt: Se eu tivesse estudado medicina, seria médico agora.

key_phrases.en: If I were brave, I would have spoken up.
key_phrases.pt: Se eu fosse corajoso, teria falado.

exercises.prompt: If I ___ that job, I would be happier now.
If she ___ (be) more careful, she wouldn't have lost her wallet.
answers: were

exercises.prompt: Se eu tivesse aprendido inglês antes, estaria trabalhando no exterior agora.
answers: If I had learned English earlier, I would be working abroad now.
If I had learnt English earlier, I would be working abroad now.

exercises.prompt: Monte a frase: se eu fosse rico, teria comprado aquela casa
answers: If I were rich, I would have bought that house.

lessons.title: I wish e if only
lessons.objective: Expressar arrependimentos e desejos sobre o presente e o passado.
lessons.explanation:
- **wish + past simple** = desejo sobre o presente: *I wish I spoke Spanish.* (não falo)
- **wish + past perfect** = arrependimento: *I wish I had studied.*
- **if only** = mais emocional: *If only I had listened!*

key_phrases.en: I wish I lived closer to the sea.
key_phrases.pt: Queria morar mais perto do mar.

key_phrases.en: I wish I had called her.
key_phrases.pt: Queria ter ligado para ela.

exercises.prompt: I wish I ___ more time right now.
exercises.explanation: Desejo sobre o presente = past simple.

exercises.prompt: I wish I ___ (take) that opportunity last year.
answers: had taken

exercises.prompt: Queria saber falar francês.
answers: I wish I knew how to speak French.
I wish I could speak French.

exercises.prompt: 'If only I had listened!' expresses:

units.title: Relatando e pedindo coisas
units.goal: Relatar falas com precisão e pedir que alguém faça algo por você.

lessons.title: Discurso indireto avançado
lessons.objective: Relatar perguntas, ordens e pedidos com ajustes de tempo e pronome.
lessons.explanation:
- Ordens: *"Sit down."* → *He told me to sit down.*
- Pedidos: *"Could you help me?"* → *She asked me to help her.*
- Perguntas sim/não: *"Are you coming?"* → *He asked if I was coming.*
- Mudam também *this → that, today → that day, here → there, tomorrow → the next day.*

key_phrases.en: She asked me if I was ready.
key_phrases.pt: Ela me perguntou se eu estava pronto.

key_phrases.en: He told us to wait outside.
key_phrases.pt: Ele nos mandou esperar do lado de fora.

exercises.prompt: 'Close the door.' → She told him ___.
'Are you coming?' → He asked ___ I was coming. (se)
answers: if
whether

exercises.prompt: Ele me pediu para esperar aqui.
answers: He asked me to wait here.
He asked me to wait there.

exercises.prompt: 'I'll see you tomorrow.' → He said he would see me ___.

lessons.title: Verbos de relato e a forma -ing ou to
lessons.objective: Usar verbos como suggest, admit e recommend com a estrutura correta.
lessons.explanation:
Alguns verbos pedem gerúndio, outros infinitivo:

- *suggest / admit / avoid / deny + -ing*: *He admitted making a mistake.*
- *agree / refuse / promise / offer + to*: *She refused to apologize.*
- *suggest that + sujeito + verbo base*: *I suggest you call him.*

key_phrases.en: She suggested going to the beach.
key_phrases.pt: Ela sugeriu ir à praia.

key_phrases.en: He refused to answer.
key_phrases.pt: Ele se recusou a responder.

exercises.prompt: He admitted ___ the money.
They refused ___ (help) us.
answers: to help

exercises.prompt: Eu sugiro que você tente de novo.
answers: I suggest you try again.
I suggest that you try again.

exercises.prompt: She promised ___ on time.

lessons.title: Causative: have e get something done
lessons.objective: Dizer que alguém fez algo para você.
lessons.explanation:
Use **have / get + objeto + particípio** para serviços:

- *I had my car repaired.* (mandei consertar o carro)
- *She is getting her hair cut tomorrow.*

Não confunda com *I had my car*: a estrutura causativa é sempre com particípio.

key_phrases.en: I need to have my laptop checked.
key_phrases.pt: Preciso mandar verificar meu notebook.

key_phrases.en: We had the kitchen painted.
key_phrases.pt: Mandamos pintar a cozinha.

exercises.prompt: I ___ my hair ___ yesterday. (cortar, por outra pessoa)
We need to get the roof ___ (repair).
answers: repaired

exercises.prompt: Vou mandar consertar meu celular.
answers: I'm going to have my phone repaired.
I am going to have my phone repaired.
I'm going to get my phone repaired.

exercises.prompt: Monte a frase: ela mandou pintar o carro
answers: She had her car painted.

units.title: Conectores e nuances
units.goal: Usar conectores para argumentar e expressões naturais como um falante fluente.

lessons.title: Conectores de contraste e concessão
lessons.objective: Ligar ideias opostas com however, although e despite.
lessons.explanation:
- **although / even though** + oração: *Although it was cold, we went out.*
- **despite / in spite of** + substantivo ou -ing: *Despite the rain, we went out.* / *Despite being tired, I finished.*
- **however** (separa com vírgula): *It was cheap. However, the quality was poor.*

key_phrases.en: Although it's expensive, it's worth it.
key_phrases.pt: Embora seja caro, vale a pena.

key_phrases.en: In spite of the delay, the show was great.
key_phrases.pt: Apesar do atraso, o show foi ótimo.

exercises.prompt: ___ the traffic, we arrived on time.
She was tired. ___, she kept working. (no entanto)
answers: However

exercises.prompt: Apesar de estar cansado, ele terminou o trabalho.
answers: Although he was tired, he finished the work.
Although he was tired, he finished the job.
Despite being tired, he finished the work.

exercises.prompt: Monte a frase: embora chova, vamos sair
answers: Although it rains, we will go out.

lessons.title: Make x do e collocations
lessons.objective: Usar as combinações de palavras que um falante nativo usaria.
lessons.explanation:
Collocations são pares que soam naturais:

- **make**: a decision, a mistake, progress, an effort
- **do**: homework, the dishes, your best, business

Ex.: *I made a mistake.* / *Did you do your homework?*

key_phrases.en: Can you do me a favour?
key_phrases.pt: Pode me fazer um favor?

key_phrases.en: We need to make a decision.
key_phrases.pt: Precisamos tomar uma decisão.

exercises.prompt: Please ___ the dishes after dinner.
I want to ___ a good impression. (causar)
answers: make

exercises.prompt: Ela fez um ótimo trabalho.
answers: She did a great job.
She did a good job.

exercises.prompt: We have made ___ this month. (progresso)

lessons.title: Idiomas do cotidiano
lessons.objective: Entender e usar expressões idiomáticas frequentes.
lessons.explanation:
Idiomas muito usados:

- *It's raining cats and dogs.* — está chovendo canivete
- *Break a leg!* — boa sorte (em apresentações)
- *Piece of cake.* — moleza
- *I'm under the weather.* — estou indisposto
- *Let's call it a day.* — vamos parar por hoje

key_phrases.en: It's a piece of cake.
key_phrases.pt: É moleza.

key_phrases.en: Let's call it a day.
key_phrases.pt: Vamos parar por hoje.

exercises.prompt: 'It's a piece of cake' means:
I feel under the ___ today. (indisposto)
answers: weather

exercises.prompt: Vamos encerrar por hoje.
answers: Let's call it a day.
Let's call it a day for today.

exercises.prompt: 'Break a leg!' is said to:
exercises.explanation: Desejo de boa sorte antes de apresentações.
